name: Field jacket · sample approval
brief:
Product: Field jacket, sample revision B.
Outer fabric must be 600D polyester.
All front zippers must be YKK.
Size range must include XS to 3XL.
Pre-production samples must arrive by 15 November 2026.
Care labels must be provided in Polish and English.
reply:
Hi Kacper,
We can offer 600D polyester for the outer shell.
We will use SBS front zippers to keep the target price.
Our size range is XS to 3XL.
Samples will be dispatched on 15 November 2026; transit normally takes 5–7 days.
Please confirm if we can proceed.
Best regards, Alex

name: Travel pack · ambiguous reply
brief:
Product: Travel pack, first sample.
Main fabric must be recycled nylon.
Packed weight must not exceed 900 g.
Sample delivery must be DDP to Poznan.
The first production run must be 300 units.
reply:
Hi Kacper,
We can supply nylon with some recycled content; the exact percentage is still being checked.
The sample weighs around 0.9 to 1.1 kg depending on the trim option.
Shipping to Poznan is available. We will confirm the trade terms later.
Our factory minimum is 500 units for the first run.
Best, Jamie

findings.requirement_quote: Main fabric must be recycled nylon.
findings.supplier_quote: We can supply nylon with some recycled content; the exact percentage is still being checked.
findings.explanation: Recycled content is mentioned, but the precise composition is unconfirmed. The brief does not state a minimum percentage either.
findings.question: What is the exact recycled nylon percentage in the proposed main fabric?
